# Uplift Dental & Orthodontics

> Uplift Dental & Orthodontics is a multi-specialty dental practice in Garden Grove, California offering comprehensive dental care under one roof — general dentistry, cosmetic dentistry, orthodontics, oral surgery, periodontics, endodontics, and pediatric dentistry. Platinum Invisalign Provider. Denti-Cal, PPO, and military insurance accepted.

## Quick Facts

- Location: 5253 Lampson Ave, Garden Grove, CA 92845
- Phone: (714) 898-3308
- Text: (888) 895-5908
- Website: https://upliftdental.com
- Hours: Mon-Fri 9am-5pm, 3rd Saturday 9am-2pm
- Founded: Multi-specialty since 2023
- Rating: 5.0 stars on Google (133+ reviews)
- Insurance: Denti-Cal, PPO, Military (TRICARE), Delta Dental, MetLife, Cigna, Aetna, Anthem Blue Cross, United Healthcare
- Financing: CareCredit, Cherry, in-house plans from $99/month

## Services

### General Dentistry
- Teeth Cleaning & Exams
- Dental Fillings

- Dentures (Full & Partial)
- Emergency Dental Care (Same-Day)

### Cosmetic Dentistry
- Porcelain Veneers & Composite Veneers
- Teeth Whitening (In-Office & Take-Home)
- Dental Bonding
- Smile Makeovers

### Orthodontics
- Invisalign Clear Aligners (Platinum Provider)
- Metal Braces
- Clear Braces
- Early Intervention Orthodontics

### Oral Surgery
- Wisdom Teeth Removal
- Dental Implants
- Bone Grafting

### Periodontics
- LANAP Laser Gum Therapy

- Periodontal Maintenance

### Endodontics
- Root Canal Therapy
- Retreatment
- Apicoectomy

1. Original multi-specialty dental practice on Lampson Ave (since 2023) — all specialists under one roof
